title: Woolworths Limited - proposed acquisition of supermarket site at Glenmore Ridge Village Centre
targets: supermarket site at Glenmore Ridge Village Centre

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.

ACCC requested further information from the merger parties. Former proposed decision date of 2 August 2012 delayed. ACCC timeline suspended pending receipt of further information from the merger parties.
ACCC received further information from the merger parties following ACCC's request for information on 12 July 2012. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC timeline suspended because of delays in merger parties responding to additional information requests made previously by the ACCC. Former proposed decision date of 6 September 2012 delayed.
ACCC received further information from merger parties. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.

Awaiting response from merger parties to the Statement of Issues. Request received from Woolworths and Stockland that the ACCC delay its decision date to allow them further time to provide a response. Former proposed decision date of 18 October 2012 delayed.
Responses to the Statement of Issues received from merger parties. ACCC timeline recommenced.

ACCC timeline suspended upon request from Woolworths that the ACCC delay its decision date again to allow it further time to provide additional information. Former proposed decision date of 8 November 2012 delayed.
ACCC received further information from Woolworths.
ACCC notified Woolworths that the information provided on 19 November 2012 was incomplete and requested further information from Woolworths in support.
Proposed decision date of 29 November 2012 delayed pending receipt of complete information from Woolworths supporting the information provided by Woolworths on 19 November 2012.
Complete information received. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC announced it would oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Woolworths Limited proposed to acquire a supermarket site at the Glenmore Ridge Village Centre. Following a public review, on 6 June 2013 the ACCC announced that it would oppose the acquisition.
